text: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつらの　ボスは　めずらしい　つよい　ポケモンを　もとめて　いるって　いってた　しゃちょうに　ひがいが　なければ　いいのだが…

structure.jp: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつらの　ボスは
structure.en: the boss of the guys who stormed this building

structure.jp: めずらしい　つよい　ポケモンを　もとめて　いるって
structure.en: that he is after rare, strong Pokémon

structure.jp: しゃちょうに　ひがいが　なければ
structure.en: if no harm comes to the president

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: もとめて　いるって　いってた
patterns.explanation: って is the casual spoken form of と, and it wraps up what someone said before いう. もとめて　いるって　いってた = 'he was saying that he's after them'.

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.span: なければ　いいのだが
patterns.explanation: A ば-form followed by いい means 'it would be good if', and with a trailing が it becomes a worried hope. ひがいが　なければ　いいのだが = 'I hope there's no harm'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつら
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which one. この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつら = 'the guys who stormed into this building'.
